card.name: First digit before a final 5
card.fires_on: The first digit of a two-digit number whose next digit is 5, such as 1 in 15, 4 in 45, 6 in 65 or 3 in 35. It appears in ranges, ages, and measurements.

modes.label: Digit 1 before 5
modes.description: The digit 1 starts a number like 15 in a range or pressure value.

modes.label: Other tens digits before 5
modes.description: A digit such as 3, 4 or 6 starts an age or level ending in 5.
modes.example: contraindicated in women over <<3>>5 years of age who smoke

card.writes: It promotes the digit 5 and the word five in several languages, and suppresses one, so it pushes the next digit toward 5.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number like 15, 35 or 65 when the next digit is expected to be 5.
